description: This file defines FastAPI route handlers for an API that constructs network/relationship graphs for an insurance fraud detection platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving full graphs, entity-specific graphs, and claim-centered graphs, utilizing a supabase database connection to fetch relationship data and build node/edge representations. Additionally, it contains internal helper functions for constructing nodes and edges and resolving entity labels.

methods.name: dict _build_node(entity_type: str, entity_id: str, label: str, metadata: dict = None)
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing a network node with entity type, id, label, and optional metadata.

methods.name: dict _build_edge(rel: dict)
methods.description: Constructs a dictionary representing a network edge from a relationship record, including source, target, types, relationship type, and strength.

methods.name: get_network_graph( limit: int = Query(100, description="Max relationships to return", ge=1, le=500), )
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch the complete network graph of relationships with optional limit parameter.

methods.name: get_entity_network(entity_type: str, entity_id: str)
methods.description: API endpoint to fetch the network graph centered on a specified entity type and id.

methods.name: get_claim_network(claim_id: str)
methods.description: API endpoint to build a network graph around a specific claim, including related policyholders and relationships.

methods.name: None _resolve_node_labels(nodes_map: dict)
methods.description: Internal helper to label nodes with human-readable info by querying respective entity tables.

ctags.name: _build_node
ctags.pattern: /^def _build_node(entity_type: str, entity_id: str, label: str, metadata: dict = None) -> dict:$/
ctags.signature: (entity_type: str, entity_id: str, label: str, metadata: dict = None)

ctags.name: get_network_graph
ctags.signature: ( limit: int = Query(100, description="Max relationships to return", ge=1, le=500), )
